segments.name: Commercial mortgage loans
segments.description: Directly originates and manages senior floating-rate commercial real estate loans secured by institutional quality properties.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company consists of a single operating and reportable segment and the consolidated financial statements and notes thereto are presented as a single reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest on senior floating-rate commercial real estate loans and other debt-like investments in its mortgage loan portfolio.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generally derives its revenues from directly originating, investing in and managing senior floating-rate commercial mortgage loans and other debt and debt-like commercial real estate investments, which largely includes interest income, net of premium amortization and discount accretion, from its investment portfolio of mortgage loans held-for-investment.
